description: This file defines a PHP trait, 'DecoratorTrait', within the 'OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator' namespace. The trait provides methods for lazy instantiation and retrieval of a decorator object associated with a class, including logic to determine the decorator class name based on the host class.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object, instantiating it if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: getDecoratorClassName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the class name of the decorator based on the current class name.
